neighbours.label: 'that' / 'this' (and the 's after it) used as a pronoun that starts a new comment clause right after a comma, dash or bracket (', that gives', '– that's', ', this is'); quiet on 'that' as a complementiser or relative inside the clause, and on ', which'
fire: The battery lasts about nine hours – that's nearly a full working day.
Carrots are rich in a pigment called carotene, that turns into vitamin A in the body.
The usual thickness is 18 mm plywood, this is what most builders keep in stock.
Our club has 240 members – that's twice as many as last year.
The oldest of them is the stone bridge, that's been standing since Roman times.
He ran the course in 52 minutes, that would be a record for his age.
The cheapest option is the night bus, this leaves from the main square.
Each jar holds 300 grams (that will be enough for six portions).
quiet: He told me that the battery lasts about nine hours on a full charge.
Carrots are rich in a pigment called carotene, which turns into vitamin A in the body.
Most builders keep 18 mm plywood in stock because it is the usual thickness.
I believe that's twice as many members as last year.
The oldest of them is the stone bridge, standing since Roman times.
He ran the course in 52 minutes, a record for his age.
The night bus that leaves from the main square is the cheapest option.
Each jar holds 300 grams (enough for six portions).

notes: Card: '’s' x6, ' that' x6, "'s" x6, 'that' x5, ' this' x2. Probes: comma/dash + that/this 0.78-0.96; 'said that', 'I think that's', ', which', possessive 's 0.01-0.10.
